title: Capture the memory and task components of a CLI task-sync export on one store snapshot, or refuse when the store moved between them
outcome: Capture the memory and task components of a CLI task-sync export on one store snapshot, or refuse when the store moved between them
acceptance: engram task-sync export --include-memories publishes a memory component and a task component that describe the same store state, or refuses naming a store change between their captures, with a test of a store write between the two captures
